findings: The measured centre seam has about 2.6 mm of depth separation even though upper and lower lip silhouette vertices overlap vertically.
A 1.0 mm depth correction raises body self-collision pairs from 171 to 365 at neutral.
The 1.6 mm and 2.2 mm corrections raise neutral self-collision pairs to 368 and 382 respectively.
All depth variants leave the visible black band substantially unchanged.
decision: Reject all r1112 variants and retain r1110 as the active offline study.
nextAction: Do not compress the existing inner-lip surfaces; isolate the mouth-interior topology and determine whether a controlled retopology is required.
